cohort: 31 women admitted with complete uterine rupture to a rural tertiary center in Northern India between January 2016 and December 2018
finding: Complete uterine rupture had a prevalence of 0.34% (31/9156 deliveries) and was associated with high perinatal and maternal morbidity and mortality.
gest_age: Term gestation in the majority of cases (66.7%)
